description: Every indicator this project publishes, long, with its unit and the silver series it is built from. Stored as parquet partitioned by INDICATOR and exported as SDMX-CSV.
Series fetched from FRED's graph export.
Series read from the Commission's monthly survey workbooks.
Series fetched from the OeNB web service with the oenb Python package.
Prices from Yahoo Finance's chart API.
Daily weather from Open-Meteo's ERA5 archive.
Dummies built from docs/policy_events.csv; gold, as they are this project's own records.
